-- What a client importing `Proof.sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.Laws` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def smd.isSchema_agree.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (sc : Loc) (S S' : smd.Schema), smd.isSchema sc S ∗ smd.isSchema sc S' ⊢ ⌜S = S'⌝

def smd.isUpdater_intro.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (u : Loc) (cv : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.merge.Converter) (igf igfl : GoMap) (rion : Bool),
    typedPointsto u { Converter' := cv, IgnoredFields' := igf, IgnoreFilter' := igfl, returnInputOnNoop' := rion }
        DFrac.discard ⊢
      smd.isUpdater u cv igf igfl rion

def smd.isIface_scalar.law : Prop :=
  (True ⊢ smd.isIface GoInterface.nil smd.UVal.null) ∧
    (∀ (b : Bool), True ⊢ smd.isIface (interface.mkOk go.bool (intoVal b)) (smd.UVal.bool b)) ∧
      (∀ (n : w64), True ⊢ smd.isIface (interface.mkOk go.int64 (intoVal n)) (smd.UVal.int n)) ∧
        ∀ (s : GoString), True ⊢ smd.isIface (interface.mkOk go.string (intoVal s)) (smd.UVal.str s)

def smd.isTypeRef_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (tr : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.TypeRef) (t : smd.TypeRef),
    smd.isTypeRef tr t ⊢ □ smd.isTypeRef tr t

def smd.applyResult_premise.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (rion : Bool) (live config : smd.UVal) (ver : GoString) (mf : smd.MF)
    (mgr : GoString) (force : Bool) (obj : Option smd.UVal) (mf' : smd.MF),
    S.WF →
      smd.conforms S t live →
        smd.conforms S t config →
          smd.keysSorted mf = true →
            (∀ (m : GoString) (e : smd.VSet), mf.get m = some e → e.version = ver ∧ smd.keysWithItems S t e.set) →
              smd.applyResult S t rion live config ver mf mgr force = smd.ApplyOutcome.ok obj mf' →
                smd.keysSorted mf' = true ∧
                  ∀ (m : GoString) (e : smd.VSet),
                    mf'.get m = some e → e.version = ver ∧ smd.keysWithItems S t e.set ∧ smd.schemaConsistent S t e.set

def smd.ownSet_empty.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Loc),
    typedPointsto p (zero_val sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.Set') (DFrac.own 1) ⊢
      smd.ownSet p smd.PathSet.empty

def smd.isTV_schema.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (p sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (x : smd.UVal), smd.isTV p sc S t x ⊢ smd.isSchema sc S ∗ ⌜S.WF⌝

def smd.isConflicts_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.merge.Conflicts) (cs : List (GoString × smd.Path)),
    smd.isConflicts s cs ⊢ □ smd.isConflicts s cs

def smd.isIface_agree.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (i : GoInterface) (x y : smd.UVal), smd.isIface i x ∗ smd.isIface i y ⊢ ⌜x = y⌝

def smd.isIdentityConverter_intro.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (T : go.GoType) (v : val),
    ((□
          ∀ p ver Φ,
            ▷ Φ (intoVal p, intoVal GoInterface.nil) -∗
              WP (((intoVal (methods T go!"Convert" v)) (intoVal p)) (intoVal ver))
                {{ Φ }}) ∗
        □
          ∀ e Φ,
            ▷ Φ (intoVal false) -∗
              WP
                ((intoVal
                    (methods T
                      go!"IsMissingVersionError"
                      v))
                  (intoVal e))
                {{ Φ }}) ⊢
      smd.isIdentityConverter (interface.mkOk T v)

def smd.isVal_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (v : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Value) (x : smd.UVal), smd.isVal v x ⊢ □ smd.isVal v x

def smd.updateResult_premise.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (live new : smd.UVal) (ver : GoString) (mf : smd.MF) (mgr : GoString),
    S.WF →
      smd.conforms S t live →
        smd.conforms S t new →
          smd.keysSorted mf = true →
            (∀ (m : GoString) (e : smd.VSet), mf.get m = some e → e.version = ver ∧ smd.keysWithItems S t e.set) →
              smd.keysSorted (smd.updateResult S t live new ver mf mgr) = true ∧
                ∀ (m : GoString) (e : smd.VSet),
                  (smd.updateResult S t live new ver mf mgr).get m = some e →
                    e.version = ver ∧ smd.keysWithItems S t e.set ∧ smd.schemaConsistent S t e.set

def smd.isValF_agree.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (v : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Value) (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) (x y : smd.UVal),
    smd.isValF v dq1 x ∗ smd.isValF v dq2 y ⊢ ⌜x = y⌝

def smd.isSet_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Loc) (S : smd.PathSet), smd.isSet p S ⊢ □ smd.isSet p S

def smd.isPaths_length.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (ss : List GoSlice) (ps : List smd.Path), smd.isPaths ss ps ⊢ ⌜ss.length = ps.length⌝

def smd.isUpdater_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (u : Loc) (cv : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.merge.Converter) (igf igfl : GoMap) (rion : Bool),
    smd.isUpdater u cv igf igfl rion ⊢ □ smd.isUpdater u cv igf igfl rion

def smd.isSet_agree.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Loc) (S S' : smd.PathSet), smd.isSet p S ∗ smd.isSet p S' ⊢ ⌜S = S'⌝

def smd.sepL {α : Type} (f : α → IProp GF) (xs : List α) : IProp GF :=
  List.foldr (fun a acc => iprop(f a ∗ acc)) iprop(True) xs

def smd.isTV_conforms.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (p sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (x : smd.UVal), smd.isTV p sc S t x ⊢ ⌜smd.conforms S t x⌝

def smd.isConflicts_intro.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.merge.Conflicts)
    (xs : List sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.merge.Conflict) (cs : List (GoString × smd.Path)),
    xs.length = cs.length →
      ⊢
        ownSlice s xs DFrac.discard -∗
          smd.sepL (fun xc => iprop(⌜xc.fst.Manager' = xc.snd.fst⌝ ∗ smd.isPath xc.fst.Path' xc.snd.snd)) (xs.zip cs) -∗
            smd.isConflicts s cs

def smd.isTV_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (p sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (x : smd.UVal), smd.isTV p sc S t x ⊢ □ smd.isTV p sc S t x

def smd.isPaths_cons.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : GoSlice) (ss : List GoSlice) (p : smd.Path) (ps : List smd.Path),
    smd.isPaths (s :: ss) (p :: ps) ⊣⊢ smd.isPath s p ∗ smd.isPaths ss ps

def smd.MF_ext.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : smd.MF), smd.keysSorted a = true → smd.keysSorted b = true → (∀ (m : GoString), a.get m = b.get m) → a = b

def smd.freshAtom_map.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Atom) (fsl : GoSlice)
    (sfs : List sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.StructField) (fs : List (GoString × smd.TypeRef))
    (etv : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.TypeRef) (e : Option smd.TypeRef) (rel : smd.ElemRel),
    a.Scalar' = null →
      a.List' = null →
        sfs.length = fs.length →
          (∀ (sf : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.StructField), sf ∈ sfs → sf.Default' = GoInterface.nil) →
            ⊢
              typedPointsto
                  (structFieldRef sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Map
                    go!"Fields" a.Map')
                  fsl DFrac.discard -∗
                ownSlice fsl sfs DFrac.discard -∗
                  smd.sepL (fun sf => iprop(⌜sf.fst.Name' = sf.snd.fst⌝ ∗ smd.isTypeRef sf.fst.Type' sf.snd.snd))
                      (sfs.zip fs) -∗
                    typedPointsto
                        (structFieldRef sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Map
                          go!"Unions" a.Map')
                        slice.nil DFrac.discard -∗
                      typedPointsto
                          (structFieldRef sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Map
                            go!"ElementType" a.Map')
                          etv DFrac.discard -∗
                        (match e with
                          | some t => smd.isTypeRef etv t
                          | none =>
                            ⌜etv.NamedType' = null ∧
                                etv.Inlined'.Scalar' = null ∧
                                  etv.Inlined'.List' = null ∧
                                    etv.Inlined'.Map' = null ∧
                                      etv.ElementRelationship' = null ∧ etv.Nullable' = false⌝) -∗
                          typedPointsto
                              (structFieldRef sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Map
                                go!"ElementRelationship"
                                a.Map')
                              rel.goName DFrac.discard -∗
                            typedPointsto
                                (structFieldRef sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Map
                                  go!"once" a.Map')
                                (zero_val sync.Once) (DFrac.own 1) -∗
                              typedPointsto
                                  (structFieldRef sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Map go!"m" a.Map')
                                  (zero_val (sync.atomic.Pointer GoMap)) (DFrac.own 1) -∗
                                smd.freshAtom a (smd.Atom.map fs e rel)

def smd.PathSet_ext.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : smd.PathSet), (∀ (q : smd.Path), q ∈ a ↔ q ∈ b) → a = b

def smd.isIface_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (i : GoInterface) (x : smd.UVal), smd.isIface i x ⊢ □ smd.isIface i x

def smd.freshAtom_list.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Atom) (v : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.List')
    (ksl : GoSlice) (e : smd.TypeRef) (rel : smd.ElemRel) (ks : List GoString),
    a.Scalar' = null →
      a.Map' = null →
        v.ElementRelationship' = rel.goName →
          v.Keys' = ksl →
            ⊢
              typedPointsto a.List' v DFrac.discard -∗
                ownSlice ksl ks DFrac.discard -∗
                  smd.isTypeRef v.ElementType' e -∗ smd.freshAtom a (smd.Atom.list e rel ks)

def smd.isFieldList_intro.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : GoSlice) (fs : List sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Field) (fl : smd.FieldList),
    fs.length = List.length fl →
      ⊢
        ownSlice s fs DFrac.discard -∗
          smd.sepL (fun ff => iprop(⌜ff.fst.Name' = ff.snd.fst⌝ ∗ smd.isVal ff.fst.Value' ff.snd.snd)) (fs.zip fl) -∗
            smd.isFieldList s fl

def smd.reconcile_mem.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (s : smd.PathSet) (q : smd.Path),
    q ∈ smd.reconcile S t s ↔ (q ∈ s ∧ ¬∃ p, p ∈ smd.atomicNodes S t s ∧ p <+: q) ∨ q ∈ smd.atomicNodes S t s

def smd.ensureNamed_mem.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (s : smd.PathSet) (q : smd.Path),
    q ∈ smd.ensureNamed S t s ↔
      q ∈ s ∨
        ∃ p n,
          q = p ++ [smd.PE.field n] ∧
            (∃ r, r ≠ [] ∧ q ++ r ∈ s) ∧
              ∃ fs e rel,
                ((smd.typeAlong S (some t) p).bind fun t => S.find t.name) = some (smd.Atom.map fs e rel) ∧
                  (smd.lookupKV n fs).isSome = true

def smd.isIface_list.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (sl : GoSlice) (xs : List GoInterface) (vs : List smd.UVal),
    xs.length = vs.length →
      ⊢
        ownSlice sl xs DFrac.discard -∗
          smd.sepL (fun xv => smd.isIface xv.fst xv.snd) (xs.zip vs) -∗
            smd.isIface (interface.mkOk smd.sliceIfaceTy (intoVal sl)) (smd.UVal.list vs)

def smd.isIface_ofMap.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : GoMap) (M : GMap GoString GoInterface) (kvs : List (GoString × smd.UVal)),
    (List.map (fun x => x.fst) kvs).Nodup →
      (∀ (k : GoString), (M !! k).isSome = (smd.lookupKV k kvs).isSome) →
        ⊢
          ownMap m DFrac.discard M -∗
            smd.sepL (fun kv => iprop(∃ x, ⌜M !! kv.fst = some x⌝ ∗ smd.isIface x kv.snd)) kvs -∗
              smd.isIface (interface.mkOk smd.mapStrIfaceTy (intoVal m)) (smd.UVal.ofMap kvs)

def smd.isPath_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : GoSlice) (p : smd.Path), smd.isPath s p ⊢ □ smd.isPath s p

def smd.isSchema_intro.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema), smd.freshSchema sc S ⊢ |={⊤}=> smd.isSchema sc S

def smd.isMF_intro.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.ManagedFields) (M : GMap GoString GoInterface)
    (ms : List (GoString × smd.VSet)),
    (List.map (fun x => x.fst) ms).Nodup →
      (∀ (k : GoString), (M !! k).isSome = (smd.lookupKV k ms).isSome) →
        ⊢
          ownMap m DFrac.discard M -∗
            smd.sepL (fun me => iprop(∃ i, ⌜M !! me.fst = some i⌝ ∗ smd.isVSet i me.snd)) ms -∗
              smd.isMF m (smd.MF.ofList ms)

def smd.isTypeRef_intro.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (tr : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.TypeRef) (t : smd.TypeRef),
    tr.Inlined'.Scalar' = null →
      tr.Inlined'.List' = null →
        tr.Inlined'.Map' = null →
          tr.ElementRelationship' = null →
            tr.Nullable' = t.nullable → typedPointsto tr.NamedType' t.name DFrac.discard ⊢ smd.isTypeRef tr t

def smd.freshSchema_intro.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (sc : Loc) (tys : GoSlice) (tds : List sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.TypeDef) (S : smd.Schema),
    tds.length = S.types.length →
      ⊢
        typedPointsto
            (structFieldRef sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Schema go!"Types" sc) tys
            DFrac.discard -∗
          ownSlice tys tds DFrac.discard -∗
            smd.sepL (fun ta => iprop(⌜ta.fst.Name' = ta.snd.fst⌝ ∗ smd.freshAtom ta.fst.Atom' ta.snd.snd))
                (tds.zip S.types) -∗
              typedPointsto
                  (structFieldRef sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Schema go!"once" sc)
                  (zero_val sync.Once) (DFrac.own 1) -∗
                typedPointsto (structFieldRef sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Schema go!"m" sc)
                    (zero_val (sync.atomic.Pointer GoMap)) (DFrac.own 1) -∗
                  smd.freshSchema sc S

def smd.isValF_split.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (v : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Value) (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) (x : smd.UVal),
    smd.isValF v (dq1 • dq2) x ⊣⊢ smd.isValF v dq1 x ∗ smd.isValF v dq2 x

def smd.freshAtom_scalar.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Atom) (s : smd.Scalar),
    a.List' = null → a.Map' = null → typedPointsto a.Scalar' s.goName DFrac.discard ⊢ smd.freshAtom a (smd.Atom.scalar s)

def smd.isMF_agree.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.ManagedFields) (a b : smd.MF),
    smd.isMF m a ∗ smd.isMF m b ⊢ ⌜a = b⌝

def smd.isIdentityConverter_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (cv : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.merge.Converter), smd.isIdentityConverter cv ⊢ □ smd.isIdentityConverter cv

def smd.isVSet_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (i : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.VersionedSet) (e : smd.VSet), smd.isVSet i e ⊢ □ smd.isVSet i e

def smd.isMF_sorted.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.ManagedFields) (mf : smd.MF),
    smd.isMF m mf ⊢ ⌜smd.keysSorted mf = true⌝

def smd.keysWithItemsB_iff.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (s : smd.PathSet), smd.keysWithItemsB S t s = true ↔ smd.keysWithItems S t s

def smd.isPath_intro.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : GoSlice) (es : List sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.PathElement) (p : smd.Path),
    es.length = List.length p →
      ⊢ ownSlice s es DFrac.discard -∗ smd.sepL (fun ep => smd.isPE ep.fst ep.snd) (es.zip p) -∗ smd.isPath s p

def smd.isPaths_nil.law : Prop :=
  True ⊢ smd.isPaths [] []

def smd.isPaths_app.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (ss ss' : List GoSlice) (ps ps' : List smd.Path),
    ss.length = ps.length → smd.isPaths (ss ++ ss') (ps ++ ps') ⊣⊢ smd.isPaths ss ps ∗ smd.isPaths ss' ps'

def smd.mergeF_none.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (x : smd.UVal) (n : Nat),
    S.WF → smd.conforms S t x → x.size < n → smd.mergeF n S t (some x) none = some x

def smd.isMF_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.ManagedFields) (mf : smd.MF), smd.isMF m mf ⊢ □ smd.isMF m mf

def smd.isPE_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (e : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.PathElement) (pe : smd.PE), smd.isPE e pe ⊢ □ smd.isPE e pe

def smd.reconcile_id.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (s : smd.PathSet), smd.schemaConsistent S t s → smd.reconcile S t s = s

def smd.isValF_persist.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (v : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Value) (dq : DFrac) (x : smd.UVal),
    smd.isValF v dq x ⊢ |==> smd.isVal v x

def smd.isSchema_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema), smd.isSchema sc S ⊢ □ smd.isSchema sc S

def smd.atomicNodes_mem.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (s : smd.PathSet) (p : smd.Path),
    p ∈ smd.atomicNodes S t s ↔
      p ≠ [] ∧ (∃ r, r ≠ [] ∧ p ++ r ∈ s) ∧ ∃ t', smd.reconAt S t p = some t' ∧ smd.isAtomicT S t' = true

def smd.isFieldList_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : GoSlice) (fl : smd.FieldList), smd.isFieldList s fl ⊢ □ smd.isFieldList s fl

def smd.ownSet_persist.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Loc) (S : smd.PathSet), smd.ownSet p S ⊢ |==> smd.isSet p S

def smd.isPaths_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (ss : List GoSlice) (ps : List smd.Path), smd.isPaths ss ps ⊢ □ smd.isPaths ss ps
